clans.name: Cinder Clan
clans.tell: Hoods that burn at the tip and soot iron; the torch burns on, the kegs wear a chilli stem and a spice label.

clans.name: Smudge Gang
clans.tell: Paint-poured buckets for helmets, brushes for weapons, paint dripping off everything.

clans.name: Deepdelve
clans.tell: Riveted iron: lamp helmets, picks for torches, ore baskets on their backs.

clans.name: Silkcut Gang
clans.tell: Wide brims and roses, needle blades, spools on their backs; the barrel is a reel.

clans.name: Hexmoon Coven
clans.tell: Crescent horns and moon masks, quill staves, scroll cases; kegs become rune urns.

looks.name: Pigment Whelp
looks.look: paint-poured bucket helm, tube pack, paint bomb

looks.name: Tangle Whelp
looks.look: brimmed hat, spool pack, thread bomb

looks.name: Hex Runt
looks.look: crescent horns, moon mask, quill staff

looks.name: Glyph Whelp
looks.look: crescent horns, moonlit goggles, scroll cases, hex vial
